```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")
```

```{r}
movies |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Number of films:", nrow(movies)),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  filter(tomatoMeter != 0, audienceScore != 0) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(mean_gap = mean(gap), n = n()) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
movies_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_rev(fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap)))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Critic-Audience Score Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Ordered from audience-favored to critic-favored; zero indicates agreement",
    x = "Average score gap (Tomatometer - audience score)",
    y = "Genre"
  )
```

```{r}
spiderman <- movies |>
  filter(title %in% c(
    "Spider-Man",
    "Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man 3",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
    "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
    "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
  )) |>
  mutate(actor = case_when(
    title %in% c("Spider-Man", "Spider-Man 2", "Spider-Man 3") ~ "Tobey Maguire",
    str_detect(title, "^The Amazing Spider-Man") ~ "Andrew Garfield",
    str_detect(title, ":") ~ "Tom Holland"
  )) |>
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(tomatoMeter, audienceScore),
    names_to = "score_type",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  mutate(score_type = recode(
    score_type,
    tomatoMeter = "Tomatometer",
    audienceScore = "Audience"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = releaseDateTheaters, y = score, color = score_type, group = score_type)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Audience scores are highest for Tom Holland's films",
    subtitle = "Scores across the eight live-action films in release order",
    x = "Release date",
    y = "Score",
    color = "Score"
  )
```
